_metadata.description: Comprehensive platform configuration file. Adjust risk parameters, RTP, price feeds, and AI models on the fly.

risk_management.win_chance_description: Controls the global house edge and RTP (Return to Player). If set to 55.0, 55% of random outcomes are balanced by the system margin to prevent platform cash drains.
risk_management.max_payout_description: Defines the user return rate per successful trade (e.g., 1.85 means 85% net profit return on the invested amount).

market_data_sources.price_feed_description: Real-time cryptocurrency and forex quotes are pulled via secure WebSocket feeds with built-in anti-slippage and volatility smoothing filters.

ai_trading_module.ai_description: Automatically scans historical trends and current order book volatility to issue real-time CALL/UP or PUT/DOWN signals to users with explicit confidence scores.

financial_gateways.gateway_description: Direct, independent crypto acceptance without middlemen. Fully isolates financial transactions and logs them securely into the MySQL database ledger.
